correctionGroups.enemy:ashbeast: Tail root is now occluded behind the rear carapace; segmented sting arches above the body while preserving the front-facing eyes and claws.
correctionGroups.enemy:archer: A single open leather back quiver carries visible shafts and feathered nocks; duplicate sticks and exposed arrowhead-like forms are removed.
correctionGroups.boss:thorn: Replaced the back-growing branches with antler trophies lashed into cut sockets on a browband, with a suspended fang. Retained the woodland mantle and wolf anatomy.
correctionGroups.boss:crypt: Replaced the royal crown with a fitted dark cloth tricorn, including the miniature; TRUE form retains radiance without a crown overlay.
correctionGroups.boss:mire: Restored a fierce boss silhouette with tall sharp staggered spines, an angular brow, slit eye, open dark mouth and larger interlocking teeth.
correctionGroups.boss:citadel: Replaced the shovel-shaped weapon with a long pointed ridged spear and an actual shaft grip; fitted military headgear replaces the crown-shaped ornament.
